drafts.title: I Analyzed 500 Tech Tweets With an AI Roaster. 87% Had the Same Fatal Mistake.
drafts.draft:
Did a slightly masochistic experiment: fed 500 real tech tweets into an AI text roaster.

435 tweets (87%) had the same pattern:
Opened vulnerable. Closed defensive (humble-brag).

Those underperformed by 60-70%. But the 65 that survived had three things:
1. Specific failure (not generic struggle)
2. Counterintuitive insight
3. Proof (screenshots/numbers/links)

Those 65 averaged 8x higher engagement.
